import io

import shapely
from shapely import wkt


def test_wkt_loads_strict_unclosed_polygon_raises():
    # Default strict behavior should raise on unclosed ring
    with pytest.raises(Exception):
        wkt.loads("POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1))")


def test_wkt_loads_fix_structure_closes_ring():
    geom = wkt.loads("POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1))", fix_structure=True)
    assert geom.geom_type == "Polygon"
    coords = list(geom.exterior.coords)
    assert coords[0] == coords[-1]


def test_wkt_loads_fix_structure_nested_geometrycollection():
    gc = wkt.loads(
        "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION (POINT (0 0), POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1)))",
        fix_structure=True,
    )
    assert gc.geom_type == "GeometryCollection"
    assert len(gc.geoms) == 2
    poly = [g for g in gc.geoms if g.geom_type == "Polygon"][0]
    coords = list(poly.exterior.coords)
    assert coords[0] == coords[-1]


def test_wkt_file_api_passes_fix_structure():
    s = io.StringIO("POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1))")
    geom = wkt.load(s, fix_structure=True)
    assert geom.geom_type == "Polygon"
    coords = list(geom.exterior.coords)
    assert coords[0] == coords[-1]

import io
import pytest

import shapely
from shapely import wkt
from shapely.errors import UnsupportedGEOSVersionError


def test_wkt_loads_strict_unclosed_polygon_raises():
    # Default strict behavior should raise on unclosed ring
    with pytest.raises(Exception):
        wkt.loads("POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1))")


def test_wkt_loads_fix_structure_closes_ring():
    if shapely.lib.geos_version < (3, 12, 0):
        with pytest.raises(UnsupportedGEOSVersionError):
            wkt.loads("POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1))", fix_structure=True)
        return
    geom = wkt.loads("POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1))", fix_structure=True)
    assert geom.geom_type == "Polygon"
    coords = list(geom.exterior.coords)
    assert coords[0] == coords[-1]


def test_wkt_loads_fix_structure_nested_geometrycollection():
    if shapely.lib.geos_version < (3, 12, 0):
        with pytest.raises(UnsupportedGEOSVersionError):
            wkt.loads(
                "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION (POINT (0 0), POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1)))",
                fix_structure=True,
            )
        return
    gc = wkt.loads(
        "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION (POINT (0 0), POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1)))",
        fix_structure=True,
    )
    assert gc.geom_type == "GeometryCollection"
    assert len(gc.geoms) == 2
    poly = [g for g in gc.geoms if g.geom_type == "Polygon"][0]
    coords = list(poly.exterior.coords)
    assert coords[0] == coords[-1]


def test_wkt_file_api_passes_fix_structure():
    s = io.StringIO("POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1))")
    if shapely.lib.geos_version < (3, 12, 0):
        with pytest.raises(UnsupportedGEOSVersionError):
            wkt.load(s, fix_structure=True)
        return
    geom = wkt.load(s, fix_structure=True)
    assert geom.geom_type == "Polygon"
    coords = list(geom.exterior.coords)
    assert coords[0] == coords[-1]
